mo_ta_cong_viec:
About Alpha Bravo Development
Alpha Bravo Development is a fast-growing US-based software development agency specializing in fully custom software solutions for service-based businesses. We help clients develop centralized platforms that match each client’s unique workflow, giving them full ownership, customization, and long-term cost efficiency.
With a strong reputation for quality, reliability, and innovation, we're expanding our global footprint and building an elite development team in Vietnam to help drive our next phase of growth.
Overview 
We are looking for a skilled and motivated AI Engineer to join our Vietnam engineering team.
You will collaborate closely with our US and international teams to build and integrate AI-powered features and solutions that support our web and mobile applications.
This role is ideal for someone who is interested in AI, automation, and modern software development, enjoys solving practical problems, and is eager to contribute to a growing global product team.

Requirements
2+ years of experience in software development, AI/ML, or a related field.
Good programming skills in Python.
Hands-on experience working with AI/ML or Generative AI applications.
Familiarity with LLMs and AI APIs such as OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, or similar.
Basic understanding or hands-on experience with RAG, embeddings, vector databases, or prompt engineering is a plus.
Experience working with APIs and backend services.
Familiarity with Git and common software development practices.
Basic understanding of databases.
Good English communication skills, especially for working with US-based teams.
Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn new technologies.
Nice to Have
Experience with AI agent frameworks or AI automation.
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar AI frameworks.
Experience integrating AI features into existing web/mobile applications.
